concept: Review and integration: discipline as a skill you build, not a trait you either have or don't
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across delayed gratification, building a habit, and staying composed under pressure — where have you grown the most?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real area of their life where more discipline would change something

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view
